notes:
What's new in EnigmaCast

• Easier searching: Back now takes you to your search results, with the item you opened still selected.
• Richer information pages: the information page scrolls, with the full story, the episodes and the cast.
• Actors and directors: search for an actor or director and open their own page with their films and series.
• Torrents in search: when torrents are turned on, search results also show matching torrents.
• Quicker options after zapping: press OK and then Down to reach the options straight away. A hint shows you how.
• The information bar now stays on screen while you keep pressing buttons.
• Sound that always works: if your device can't play a channel's sound format, EnigmaCast automatically switches to built-in sound decoding.
• IPTV now follows your HDMI passthrough setting, just like satellite TV.
• A frozen live channel now restarts by itself, so you no longer have to zap away and back.
• Calmer loading spinner: it no longer flickers on and off.
